title: 第30章 外室
content_zh:
洪启明借到人之后，寒暄了几句又让魏乐府明天准时去报到。

    魏乐府见此，自然是带着老弟跟了过去，同时还让田牧川准备人接应他。

    如果他们的猜测没有问题，那么洪启明绝对是一条大鱼。

    所以魏乐府虽然打算去调查一下，但也得保证自己的安全。

    到时候打起来，他转头就跑，然后田牧川带人一拥而上。

    至于说他是练武的...低武只能勉强算是武，真挨一刀那也得没命。

    洪启明并没有回府，而是左顾右盼后七拐八绕的到了他府邸后的一处巷子里的某个宅子。

    “老弟，进去看看是怎么一回事。”魏乐府指挥着老弟飘了进去。

    如果说这宅子里住的是洪启明养的外室，那有可能就是莲香教的成员了。

    毕竟这是他们常用的套路。

    但也有可能里面直接就是莲香教成员，那这就意味着洪启明就是莲香教成员之一，而不是被蛊惑的。

    只是正在魏乐府观察的时候，一个人影借着夜色靠近。

    见到魏乐府后，不由得身形一顿。

    “沈铜章，你也来这盯梢洪大人？”魏乐府眼睛不由得一眯，而后礼节性拱手。

    赶来的沈千钧见到魏乐府，也是回了一礼，而后说道：“丁...铜章，你也查到洪大人养的外室上了？”

    沈千钧没想到魏乐府居然能比他更快一步。

    他没有调查，而是通过花拾蕊给的办法获得了名单。

    对此，他也是相当佩服魏乐府的，看来当初在四方武馆里确实是埋没了才能。

    加入六扇门后这才大展身手。

    “没有，我只是查到了洪大人身上。”魏乐府应完，又说道：“你和这位洪大人有什么仇怨吗？”

    “他下午上门，耍了手借刀杀人，准备让我们对付你。”

    “虽然不用他玩这一出，也照样准备对付你。”

    听到魏乐府这么直白的话，沈千钧也是有些哭笑不得，还是这么实诚。

    “所以丁铜章你就怀疑上了洪大人有问题？”沈千钧无视了魏乐府有关对付的话，这事不用他提醒都知道。
content_en:
After Hong Qiming borrowed the person, he exchanged a few words and asked Wei Yuefu to report on time tomorrow.

    Seeing this, Wei Yuefu naturally followed him with his brother, and at the same time asked Tian Muchuan to prepare people to pick him up.

    If their guess is correct, then Hong Qiming is definitely a big fish.

    Therefore, although Wei Yuefu planned to investigate, he still had to ensure his own safety.

    When the fight started, he turned around and ran away, and then Tian Muchuan led a group of people to swarm him.

    As for him practicing martial arts... A low-level martial artist can only be regarded as a martial artist, and if he really gets a knife, he will die.

    Hong Qiming did not go back to his mansion. Instead, he looked around and walked around to a house in an alley behind his mansion.

    "Brother, go in and see what's going on." Wei Yuefu directed his brother to float in.

    If Hong Qiming lived in the outer room of this house, it might be a member of the Lianxiang Sect.

    After all, this is their usual routine.

    But it is also possible that there are directly members of the Lianxiang Sect, which means that Hong Qiming is a member of the Lianxiang Sect and is not a bewitched one.

    But while Wei Yuefu was observing, a figure approached through the night.

    After seeing Wei Yuefu, he couldn't help but tremble.

    "Shen Tongzhang, are you here to follow Mr. Hong?" Wei Yuefu couldn't help but narrowed his eyes, and then politely handed over his hand.

    When Shen Qianjun came over and saw Wei Yuefu, he also bowed back, and then said: "Ding... Tongzhang, have you also found out the outer room where Lord Hong keeps him?"

    Shen Qianjun didn't expect Wei Yuefu to be one step faster than him.

    He did not investigate, but obtained the list through Hua Shirui's method.

    In this regard, he also admired Wei Yuefu. It seemed that his talent was indeed buried in Sifang Martial Arts School.

    Only after joining the Six Doors did he show off his talents.

    "No, I just found Mr. Hong." Wei Yuefu answered, and then said: "Do you have any grudge against Mr. Hong?"

    "He came to your door in the afternoon and used a trick to kill someone with a borrowed knife. He was going to let us deal with you."

    "Although he doesn't need to play this game, he is still prepared to deal with you."

    Hearing Wei Yuefu's straightforward words, Shen Qianjun was a little dumbfounded, but he was still so sincere.

    "So Ding Tongzhang, you suspect that there is something wrong with Mr. Hong?" Shen Qianjun ignored Wei Yuefu's words about dealing with it. He knew this without reminding him.
